patch.value:
## Summary

With a producer limit of 25 and an output amount limit of 2, `pm list` returns two rows but advertises a `next_cursor` after the producer's twenty-fifth row when the output token budget does not bind. Following that cursor skips 23 undisplayed rows on an unchanged tracker.

Reproduced through the installed CLI and public `PmClient` SDK on official [`@unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.6`](https://registry.npmjs.org/@unbrained/pm-cli/2026.10.6), commit [`6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/commit/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098), on Linux with Node 24.19.0. Both `unbounded` and the high finite budget `100000` reproduce the failure. The same CLI behavior reproduces on 2026.10.5, so the defect predates 2026.10.6.

Stored items remain intact. The impact is an incomplete read for callers that follow the advertised continuation.

## Independent verification on 6 October 2026

A separate clean temporary npm installation of the official `@unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.6` artifact reproduces all four combinations on Linux / Node **26.9.0**:

| Surface | Output budget | First positions | Second positions | Advertised `after_index` |
| --- | --- | --- | --- | --- |
| CLI | `unbounded` | 0, 1 | 25, 26 | 24 |
| SDK | `unbounded` | 0, 1 | 25, 26 | 24 |
| CLI | `100000` | 0, 1 | 25, 26 | 24 |
| SDK | `100000` | 0, 1 | 25, 26 | 24 |

All four receipts report `within_budget: true` and `rows_compacted: false`. A complete SDK read still returns all 30 persisted items. The tracker is unchanged between the first and second reads; this is a continuation/completeness failure, not stored-data loss.

The earlier Node 24 result above comes from the original release review. The fresh result confirms the issue independently on the same published version; it is not a full source-suite or cross-platform certification.

## CLI reproduction

Use Bash with the official 2026.10.6 `pm` executable on `PATH`. This creates only synthetic tasks in a fresh temporary tracker and keeps it unchanged during reads. Item positions below refer to the ordered complete response, not creation order.

```bash
set -euo pipefail
pm --version  # 2026.10.6

REPRO=$(mktemp -d)
export TRACKER="$REPRO/tracker"
export PM_GLOBAL_PATH="$REPRO/global"
export PM_TELEMETRY_DISABLED=1 DO_NOT_TRACK=1
export PM_CLI_DISABLE_COMPILE_CACHE=1 PM_CONTEXT_USAGE_DISABLED=1 PM_AGENT_PROBES=0
mkdir -p "$PM_GLOBAL_PATH"
cd "$REPRO"

pm init "$TRACKER" --defaults --agent-guidance skip --json >/dev/null
DESCRIPTION=$(node -p '"Evidence sentence ".repeat(40)')
for i in $(seq 0 29); do
  ID=$(printf 'row-%02d' "$i")
  pm --pm-path "$TRACKER" create task "Release matrix $i" \
    --id "$ID" --description "$DESCRIPTION" --json >/dev/null
done

pm --pm-path "$TRACKER" list --all --no-truncate \
  --output-budget unbounded --json > complete.json

for BUDGET in unbounded 100000; do
  pm --pm-path "$TRACKER" list --all --limit 25 --output-limit 2 \
    --output-budget "$BUDGET" --json > first.json
  CURSOR=$(node -p 'JSON.parse(require("fs").readFileSync("first.json", "utf8")).next_cursor')
  pm --pm-path "$TRACKER" list --all --limit 25 --output-limit 2 \
    --output-budget "$BUDGET" --after "$CURSOR" --json > second.json

  echo "Budget: $BUDGET"
  node <<'NODE'
const fs = require('node:fs');
const read = name => JSON.parse(fs.readFileSync(name, 'utf8'));
const full = read('complete.json').items.map(item => item.id);
const first = read('first.json');
const second = read('second.json');
const positions = page => page.items.map(item => full.indexOf(item.id));
console.log({first: positions(first), second: positions(second)});
// Diagnostic inspection only; consumers should treat the cursor as opaque.
console.log(JSON.parse(Buffer.from(first.next_cursor, 'base64url').toString()).after_index);
NODE
done
```

## Actual and expected results

For each budget, the observed positions are:

```text
first:  [0, 1]
second: [25, 26]
decoded first cursor after_index: 24
```

The second page should begin with positions `[2, 3]` when the returned cursor is followed. Positions 2 through 24 are skipped by the advertised continuation.

The first CLI response reports `count: 2`, `total: 30`, `applied_limit: 25`, `has_more: true`, `truncated: true`, an explicit output amount limit of 2, and `within_budget: true` / `rows_compacted: false`. It has no output-budget continuation cursor.

The defect is the misleading **non-null producer cursor**. Terminal-page behavior where a deliberate explicit amount cap omits a cursor is outside this report. No deletion, filter change or output-cursor replay is required to reproduce it.

## Public SDK reproduction

In a project that resolves `@unbrained/pm-cli@2026.10.6`, run this as an ESM file against the same unchanged synthetic tracker. Set `TRACKER` to the tracker created above and keep telemetry disabled.

```js
import { PmClient } from '@unbrained/pm-cli/sdk';

const client = new PmClient({
  pmRoot: process.env.TRACKER,
  noExtensions: true,
});
const complete = await client.listAllComplete();
const ids = complete.items.map(item => item.id);

for (const outputBudget of ['unbounded', 100000]) {
  const options = { all: true, limit: 25, outputLimit: 2, outputBudget, json: true };
  const first = await client.list(options);
  const second = await client.list({ ...options, after: first.next_cursor });
  console.log({
    outputBudget,
    first: first.items.map(item => ids.indexOf(item.id)),
    second: second.items.map(item => ids.indexOf(item.id)),
  });
}
// Both budgets: first [0, 1], second [25, 26].
```

## Source diagnosis

- [`applyAmountBound`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/src/sdk/read-output-contracts.ts#L1342-L1365) clips rows and updates counts/bounds while retaining the original producer `next_cursor`

- [`projectReadOutputRows`](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/src/sdk/read-output-contracts.ts#L1549-L1553) captures pre-cap coordinates without rebasing in the amount-only branch

- Cursor rebasing occurs inside [token compaction](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/src/sdk/read-output-contracts.ts#L1952-L1957), entered only when [the token budget binds](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/src/sdk/read-output-contracts.ts#L2049-L2058)

## Relationship to previous fixes

This is a narrow follow-up to [#1411](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1411) and [#1371](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1371), under the broader [#1363](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1363) plan. The 6 October release review separately verified traversal with both binding ceilings and deletion fallback after a compacted resumed page; the fresh confirmation above covers only this amount-only defect.

Preserve those working scopes: #1411 concerns stale replay and incorrect rebasing when both ceilings cut rows; #1371 concerns producer-fingerprint contamination and delivered counters. This amount-only route with a nonbinding budget does not exercise those failures. [#1325](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/issues/1325) concerns separate history-diff continuation.

## Existing implementation and PM lineage

- Completed precursor [pm-gh1411](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/.agents/pm/issues/pm-gh1411.toon) owns the combined amount/token-ceiling repair and initial/resumed deletion-fallback regressions.
- Completed precursor [pm-gh1371](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/.agents/pm/issues/pm-gh1371.toon) owns producer/output-budget continuation composition.
- [pm-gh1363](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/.agents/pm/plans/pm-gh1363.toon) owns lightweight defaults, complete discovery, and truthful recovery.

These are related existing records, not a newly created canonical PM item for this finding. The residual amount-only branch should retain those completed fixes and their attribution.

Extend the existing [serialized CLI continuation matrix](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/tests/integration/read-output/composed-continuation.integration.spec.ts#L124-L133) and [packed SDK consumer](https://github.com/unbraind/pm-cli/blob/6436916ca001b3252076c919143665cece075098/tests/fixtures/read-output/packed-continuation-consumer.mjs#L75-L85). The inspected primary matrix contains the binding `25/20/1700` case; add the nonbinding `25/2/unbounded` and `25/2/100000` cases so amount-only clipping is covered at the public boundary.

Deduplication for this filing checked all 693 current GitHub issue titles/bodies across open and closed states, relevant predecessor discussions, and a strict complete 2,895-item PM snapshot with no omitted fields or unreadable records. #1411 and #1371 are the related closed predecessors; no separate owner was found for the nonbinding-budget branch.

## Acceptance and regression coverage

- [ ] Any advertised continuation resumes after the last delivered row without silently skipping undisplayed rows

- [ ] Cover unchanged 30-row list pages with `limit: 25` / `outputLimit: 2`, with both unbounded and high finite budgets, through the public CLI and SDK

- [ ] Add equivalent coverage for supported search producer pages; the reproduction above establishes the list failure

- [ ] Compare exact ordered IDs throughout traversal, without Set-based deduplication that could hide missing work

- [ ] Keep truthful source-scan completeness separate from complete delivery; a complete producer scan does not certify that every requested row reached the caller

- [ ] Keep delivered counts, full totals and terminal-page behavior truthful

- [ ] Retain passing both-ceiling replay and initial/resumed deletion-fallback cases from #1411

- [ ] Preserve scope/filter-change refusal and documented explicit amount-limit semantics

## Temporary workaround

Avoid an output amount cap below the producer limit. For complete traversal, use producer paging with `--output-limit unbounded`.
GH-1413: Preserve lossless producer cursors under amount-only output caps

Rebase advertised list/search producer continuation after the last delivered row when an explicit output amount cap binds but the token budget does not. Preserve combined ceilings, deletion fallback, strict read truth and public SDK/CLI compatibility.

Exact ordered CLI and public SDK list/search traversal with producer limit25 and output-limit2 under unbounded and high finite budgets; no skipped or repeated IDs; truthful terminal counts and deliberate caps; preserve combined-ceiling and deletion-fallback controls; exact coverage and packed Node/Bun/npx/bunx acceptance.
